description: Gzipped size cap in bytes for each package entry. Each cap is the measured size plus 10 percent, rounded up to the next 10 bytes. npm run check:size fails when an entry is over its cap or has no cap. A proposal is the figure in the amendment 1 spec, kept for comparison. The measuredGzipped value of each row is the size its cap was derived from: the G0 baseline for the entries that existed at G0, the G1 measure after review round 1 for /frame, the G2 measure for /curves and /linear, the G3 measure for /values, and the G4 measure for /gesture. The sizes are in docs/baseline.md, sections G1 build, G2 build, G3 build, and G4 build. The /gesture cap of 5,680 is a proposal for the maintainer and is not approved. The entries under proposedForNewEntries do not exist yet and are not checked. The caps of /curves, /linear, /react and /values carry an approval note. The /react cap was re-derived from its G2 measure of 11,494 by the same rule, and no trim was made. Each row names, in measuredIn, the docs/baseline.md section that holds its measured table row. measuredAfterReview is the size after the review fixes, and the real headroom is the cap minus that size. The /values cap of 6,870 was derived from its G3 measure of 6,244 and approved by the maintainer; measuredAfterReview is the size after review round 2. pathAlone is the size of src/values/path.ts alone, and withoutPath is the /values entry without the path kind.
measuredWith: esbuild 0.28.2, bundle, minify, esm, React external, then gzip. See docs/baseline.md, sections G0 and G1 build.
